# JORDAN A. RIVERA
_Medical Aesthetics & Device Sales Leader_
jordan.rivera@example.test | (214) 555-0142 | Dallas, TX | linkedin.com/in/example-jrivera

## Summary
Commercial leader with 11 years of field sales experience across medical aesthetics and medical device categories, focused on consultative selling into dermatology and plastic surgery practices.
Directly relevant experience: Medical device sales, Aesthetic injectables, Capital equipment sales, Territory management, Key account management, Sales training, Certified Aesthetic Consultant, Medical aesthetics.

## Experience

**Regional Sales Manager — Meridian Aesthetics** | Mar 2019 - Present
- Grew regional revenue 43% over three years across a 6-state territory.
- Maintained 96% contract renewal across the territory.
- Built and led a team of 7 territory managers covering Texas, Oklahoma and Louisiana.
- Launched a new injectable portfolio into 180 clinics in the first 12 months.

**Territory Manager — Northstar Medical Devices** | Jan 2015 - Feb 2019
- Sold capital equipment into 120 clinics with an average deal size of $85,000.
- Trained clinic staff on device operation and treatment protocols.
- Ranked 2nd of 24 representatives nationally for two consecutive years.
- Managed a $4.2M annual quota.

**Sales Associate — Lakeside Dermatology Partners** | Jun 2012 - Dec 2014
- Supported practice expansion into two new locations.

## Education
- Bachelor of Business Administration — University of North Texas

## Certifications
- Certified Aesthetic Consultant — American Aesthetics Association
- Valid Texas Driver's License

## Skills
Medical device sales, Aesthetic injectables, Capital equipment sales, Territory management, Sales training, Key account management, Contract negotiation, CRM (Salesforce), Group purchasing organizations, Quota attainment, Team leadership, Forecasting

## Projects
- **Texas Launch Playbook**
  - Created a repeatable clinic onboarding playbook adopted across three regions.

Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Regional Sales Manager - Medical Aesthetics position at Revance Therapeutics (Dallas, TX).

Commercial leader with 11 years of field sales experience across medical aesthetics and medical device categories, focused on consultative selling into dermatology and plastic surgery practices.

Selected results from my experience:
- Grew regional revenue 43% over three years across a 6-state territory.
- Maintained 96% contract renewal across the territory.
- Built and led a team of 7 territory managers covering Texas, Oklahoma and Louisiana.

My background covers Medical device sales, Aesthetic injectables, Capital equipment sales, Territory management, Key account management, Sales training.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience fits the Regional Sales Manager - Medical Aesthetics role.

Sincerely,
JORDAN A. RIVERA
